name: chantier
description: A pane for multi-session work: your open PRs led by the one to take next and a button for its job, grouped by what they wait for (with their PR, session and ticket links), a plan of briques per repo and wave that Claude proposes and you approve, a run view of who waits on you, and a landing view (merge order, backports). Plus a status line entry with the session's ticket and brique, and relay toasts.

owner.title: GitHub owner
owner.description: Org or user your PR search is limited to. Empty searches every repo.

ticketUrl.title: Ticket URL prefix
ticketUrl.description: A ticket key is appended to it for links, e.g. https://example.atlassian.net/browse/. Empty shows keys without links.

repoAliases.title: Repo labels
repoAliases.description: repo=label pairs, comma-separated, for shorter names in the pane (e.g. my-very-long-ui-library=ui). Empty shows repo names.

clones.title: Local clones
clones.description: repo=path entries separated by commas (several paths with |), absolute or relative to your home, scanned to find the worktree of a PR's branch.

backportRepos.title: Backport repos
backportRepos.description: Comma-separated repos (name, or owner/name) whose open Mergify backports of your merged PRs are tracked.

staleDays.title: Stale after (days)
staleDays.description: An open PR with no activity for this long is listed as stale.

planDir.title: Plan folder
planDir.description: Where plans are saved, relative to your home. Keep it outside your repos.
